summary: No fundamentals thesis is broken by evidence in the files. Every held single stock still sits on the 11-03 menu with F-score 7 or higher and cfo above net income (DPZ 792M vs 602M, CARG 295M vs 156M, VRSN 1,091M vs 826M, IDXX 1,182M vs 1,059M, WMT 41.6B vs 21.9B, KR 7.3B vs 1.0B, FAST 1,296M vs 1,258M, MSCI 1,588M vs 1,202M, MSM 306.5M vs 222.6M), with no flags on any of them. The day's big single-name moves (CARG -6.7%, DPZ -2.3%, KR -2.5%, MSCI -2.3%, WMT -1.9%) are price moves, not fundamental evidence. The fundamentals file predates the CARG 11-05 print (menu_as_of 11-03, FY2025 numbers), so it cannot confirm or refute the post-print story.
update: Watch items, none a break. (1) CARG fell 6.67% on the day after the print, and the stored thesis text still says 'about 5.6% of equity and +14.7% on cost'; close.json shows weight 5.2% and +7.5% on cost (mark about $33.74 against about $31.39 average fill), so the text is stale. The $28.25 stop is about 16% below the mark, so the price rule has not tripped, and the numbers the PM cites for the print (EPS beat, guide raised, $250M buyback) are not contradicted by anything I can see. Rewrite the text to the current mark and treat further weakness as a price-stop matter. (2) DPZ's Consumer Staples rank is still a wholesale-groceries SIC artifact (gp_sector_pct 1.0 on that label), and leverage_not_up is the one failed F-score test (8 of 9); the thesis already rests on absolute quality, which holds. DPZ is about $334 against the $285 stop. (3) Consumer Staples by label (WMT, DPZ, KR) fell together again today (-1.9%, -2.3%, -2.5%), which is what the L3 stacking concern predicts; one day, not evidence of a broken thesis. KR's F-score of 7 depends on roa_improved being false and current_ratio_improved false, with net income of only 1.0B on 147.6B revenue, so it is the thinnest of the three. (4) MSCI is labelled Industrials, not Financials, and has leverage_not_up false; the quality case (cfo 1.32x net income) stands. (5) IDXX mark is about $676 against the $630 stop, about 7% away; fundamentals unchanged. (6) BND, IEF, VOO, VTI and BTC/USD have no SEC metrics, so I have no fundamentals view on them. L1 and L5 are reflected in the stored stops; I applied L3 (label caveats) and used the lessons only to check stale thesis text.
